## lib/authz

- `capabilities.ts` — Capabilities: the permissions a user holds in a team or game, for gating actions on a page.
- `http.ts` — Authorization helpers for API routes and server pages.
- `index.ts` — Authorization module: roles, permissions, ownership rules and route helpers.
- `ownership.ts` — Resource rules: actions that depend on who owns a record rather than on a role.
- `permissions.ts` — Permission table: which role holds which permission in each scope.
- `policy.ts` — Authorization policy: decide whether a user holds a permission on a target.
- `roles.ts` — Role lookups: the role a user holds in a team, game or archived game.

- `bingo-cell-repository.ts` — Bingo Cell Repository - State and content changes on bingo cells
- `cell-history-repository.ts` — Cell History Repository
- `cell-progress-repository.ts` — Cell Progress Repository - The progress a compound or iterative cell holds
- `cell-reaction-repository.ts` — Cell Reaction Repository - Teammates' emoji reactions on stamped cells

- `game-repository.ts` — Game Repository - Database operations for games

- `leaderboard-repository.ts` — Leaderboard Repository – persisted game leaderboard data
- `leave-repository.ts` — Leave Repository - Leaving a game or a team
- `prepared-resolution-repository.ts` — Prepared Resolution Repository - Reads the shared pool and copies entries out of it
- `resolution-repository.ts` — Unified Resolution Repository - Database operations for ALL resolutions
- `review-file-repository.ts` — Review File Repository - Proof files attached to review threads
- `review-thread-repository.ts` — Review Thread Repository - Database operations for proof review threads

- `team-repository.ts` — Team Repository - Database operations for teams

- `user-repository.ts` — User Repository - Database operations for users

## ws-server

- `create-server.ts` — Builds the WebSocket server: rooms joined with signed tokens, and the internal notify endpoint.
- `server.ts` — Entry point of the WebSocket server: reads the environment and starts listening.

## ws-server/messages

- `join-room.ts` — Sent by a client to join the room named by a token the Next.js server signed.
- `notification.ts` — A change the Next.js server announces, and the room whose viewers must refetch.

## ws-server/tests

- `connection-limits.test.ts` — Tests of the limits on WebSocket connections: same-origin pages only, and a message rate limit.
- `notify-endpoint.test.ts` — Tests of the internal notify endpoint the Next.js server calls.
- `rooms.test.ts` — Tests of joining rooms with signed tokens and of what each room is told on a change.
- `support.ts` — Test helpers for the WebSocket server: a server on a free port, signed tokens, clients and notify calls.
